_comment: Tier-2 fallback providers, used ONLY when every Gemini model is exhausted
AND the request is plain text (no image input, no google_search grounding).
Tried in the order listed below.
key_env       env var holding the key (checked first).
requires_key  set false for a local server that needs no key (default true).
discover      set true to auto-list models from GET {base_url}/models
instead of trusting the 'models' list (default false).
timeout       per-request seconds (default 60; local models are slower).
models        tried in order; ignored when discover is true.
Get a free key (paste into config/api_keys.json, or set the env var):
Model IDs change often (Groq retired its Llama models in Aug 2026), so edit
the 'models' lists here instead of touching code.

openai_compatible.name: Ollama (local, offline, no key, no quota)
